summary: Brian maps the full photonics chain after China demonstrated a single fiber strand carrying 5x more data, arguing copper is hitting a physical wall as data centers race from 800G to 1.6T and 3.2T optics. He covers the layers others skip: glass, connectors, systems, and the materials/test gear underneath. Corning (GLW, CONDITIONAL_BUY) is the 175-year-old fiber leader with ~20% global share and anchor-supplier status at Meta, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and Nvidia simultaneously — optical profit grew 93% on 36% revenue growth — but rich at PEG ~3, so wait for a pullback. Amphenol (APH, BUY) is the connector giant whose AI data-center segment grew 80%+ organically with a record $9.4B order book, reasonably priced at PEG ~0.7. Credo (CRDO, CONDITIONAL_BUY) bridges copper and optics with 68% gross margins and revenue tripling in six quarters, but 88% of revenue comes from three customers at 35x sales. Ciena (CIEN) is the coherent-optics leader with a $7B backlog, but at ~120x forward earnings it is priced for perfection — UNCERTAIN. AXT Inc (AXTI) grows the indium-phosphide wafers every optical laser needs and has a record backlog, but faces China export-permit risk, dilution and ongoing losses — UNCERTAIN and lottery-ticket sized. Viavi (VIAV, CONDITIONAL_BUY) is the pick-agnostic test-gear maker with network testing up 54%, PEG ~1.4 — wait for a cooldown. He also flags the new FOTO pure-play photonics ETF (concentrated, 0.75% fee, no track record) as a one-click alternative. A Seeking Alpha sponsorship segment is included.
title: Millionaires are Hitting These 10X Stocks HARD!
